propositions: Mapped Jira project keys that are decommissioned or access-restricted are not validated before reconcile pass mutations, causing failures deep in fan-out via ACLI errors
resolve_project returns legacy_default verbatim without validation, causing unbound tickets to create into wrong or nonexistent projects when legacy_default is misconfigured

Reconcile pass must validate all projects in read_projects().keys(), configured query_project fallback, and legacy_default are visible to the bot via GET /rest/api/3/project/search before any outbound write
Preflight probe must fail closed (raise TransportUnavailableError) if pagination exhausts page cap or transport errors occur, rather than treating incomplete visibility as authoritative
Preflight is wired only for mutating passes (skipped for preview/dry-run/reconcile-check) and only for configured Cloud backend, with observable skip signal for other backends
Missing or invisible required projects abort with actionable error message and OPERATIONAL_FAILURE exit before reconcile_once is called
